title: Fast repath and prefetch-stitch to recover TTFT for long-context fanouts
creator: Ava Chen
description: Summary: Multiple enterprise customers observed a 2x-6x increase in time-to-first-token (TTFT) and reduced tokens/sec for long-context (>= 4k tokens) conversational fanouts across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments after a staged rollout of a kernel-selection heuristic (runtime-1.18.2). Root cause appears to be an overly aggressive kernel-score penalty for large KV-cache footprints combined with a widened microbatch window, which increased scheduling latency for first-token paths. This ticket coordinates an emergency workaround (fast repath + prefetch-stitch) and follow-up permanent fixes.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use a decoder-only long-context model with >4k context and a multi-turn conversation (prefix + user prompt) that triggers KV-prefetch. 2) Fan out requests from 3 concurrent sessions to the same worker pool (replicate multi-tenant traffic shape). 3) Send a burst of high-priority single-turn prompts to measure first-token latency. 4) Observe increased scheduler queue time and deferred kernel selection leading to TTFT spikes. Reproducible in staging with runtime-1.18.2 and a seeded workload script (repo: github.com/redwood-inference/incident-scripts, script: long_context_fanout.py).
rollback_plan: 1) Revert kernel-selector config flags to previous scoring weights (feature-flag rollback). 2) Re-enable legacy kernel affinity for the affected GPU types. 3) Restore microbatch window to previous value (6ms -> 3ms). 4) If rollback of config does not stabilize, perform a full node-group traffic failover to kernel-legacy via routing layer and hot-swap canary traffic back. Rollback tested on canary cluster before wider rollout.
short_term_mitigation:
- Implement traffic repath rule to prefer 'kernel-legacy' for sessions with long-context and priority>=P1.
- Enable aggressive session-level KV prefetch stitching (keep-first-key) for conversational sessions to reduce per-request warmup.
- Decrease microbatch window for first-token pipeline from 6ms to 3ms for affected pools.
- Hedge high-priority first-token requests with a 30ms second probe to an alternative worker pool for P0 customers.
- Add a rate-limited warmup-credit grant for tenants reporting escalations.
long_term_plan:
- Rework kernel scoring to account for KV-cache size and amortized priming cost (metric: priming_ms_per_token).
- Add a scheduler telemetry dimension that correlates kernel-score delta with TTFT per model family.
- Expand prefetched prefix cache with LRU-leaky eviction tuned for multi-tenant fanout.
- Add e2e synthetic workload tests in CI that exercise long-context multi-tenant fanout shapes.
- Post-mortem to capture decisions and prevention guardrails.
acceptance_criteria: TTFT for first token on long-context conversations returns to <=1.5x baseline within 60 minutes of mitigation for P0 tenants
No regression in throughput (tokens/sec) across standard short-context workloads
Canary metrics show stable kernel-selection distribution after repath for 24h
Engineering runbook updated and applied to Dedicated/Private deploy documentation
